description.text: The first Trick or Trade BOOster Bundle, which The Pokémon Company International brought out on 1 September 2022 as something to hand out to trick-or-treaters instead of candy, sold at grocery stores and mass retailers as well as the Pokémon Center. A bundle held 40 mini packs of three cards. Its 30 cards are reprints, mostly of spooky Pokémon such as Zubat, Gengar, Pumpkaboo, Mimikyu and Polteageist, from nine Sword & Shield expansions, Rebel Clash to Astral Radiance. Each keeps its number and has a Pikachu jack-o'-lantern stamped on the bottom right of its picture. Ten are holo: Trevenant, Chandelure, Mimikyu, Darkrai, Gengar, Hatterene, Gourgeist, Mewtwo, Dusknoir and Mismagius.
